premises.text: People want to showcase their brand clothing to others.
premises.evidence_span: They want to talk about them. They want others to get to know what they have, what they wear.

premises.text: A multifunctional tagging app can help users identify brands.
premises.evidence_span: thanks to tagbrand.com you have just got to know which brand it is.

premises.text: Users can ask the community to identify brands they see.
premises.evidence_span: just to run our iPhone app and ask community what brand it is.

premises.text: The app can help users make better clothing choices through polls.
premises.evidence_span: take a photo of yourself and create a poll.

premises.text: The web service connects users based on brand loyalty.
premises.evidence_span: a powerful web service which brings people together on basis of their brand's loyalty.

premises.text: Brands will pay to communicate with their fans through the platform.
premises.evidence_span: Brands will love it and they will pay us for it.

premises.text: A marketplace will be created for stores in the branding area.
premises.evidence_span: we are creating a special marketplace for stores which appears in a branding area.

premises.text: The service aims to expand internationally.
premises.evidence_span: we are going to create an international service.

value.text: Users can easily identify and showcase their brand clothing.
